name: Legend of the Ep0ch Wyrm
description: A BBS door game in the outline: players are notes, stats are chips, fifteen forest fights a day, and the town's Daily News.

scripts.name: wyrm
scripts.about: Plays one move for the player whose sheet you press from: wyrm do=forest, hit, run, heal, train, buy, deposit, withdraw, sleep, ambush, wyrm, join.

scripts.name: wyrm-sheet
scripts.about: Draws a player's note: the chips and a press for every move. A line `wyrm-sheet::` shows it.

scripts.name: wyrm-town
scripts.about: Draws a town note: the players ranked, the join button and today's Daily News. A line `wyrm-town::` shows it.
